title: feat(study): a back-to-top button on long squads
body:
**Size:** S

Getting back to the top of a 26-player squad on Study takes several swipes. Show a small "Back to top" button at the bottom of `app/team/[squadId]/study.tsx` once the list has scrolled past its first screen; a tap scrolls the `FlatList` to the top, animated, and the button fades out.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The button appears only past the first screen, in grid and list, and VoiceOver reads it as "Back to top"
- [ ] Its fade stays under 300 ms
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
source: synthetic; replaced 2026-10-21, since the main pin already has the clear button the first version asked for
why: An S feature on main with someone's uncommitted edit in the tree: a worktree keeps that edit safe.
